Aboutme

Currently: BScHons Computer Science at the University of Pretoria. Open to graduate roles and internships in machine learning, data science and software development.

I'm a hardworking, curious and dedicated person who thrives on being challenged to grow - strong technical knowledge paired with collaborative instincts, and the project management experience to step into a leadership role when one is needed.

I completed my BSc IT at North-West University and am now pursuing Honours in Computer Science at the University of Pretoria, focused on machine learning, data science and data engineering.

Day to day that means Python, SQL, Java and JavaScript, React and Node on the front end, and AWS underneath - Lambda, RDS, EC2 and S3. Away from the desk: automobiles, emerging tech, video games, and time with family and friends.
